name: Quire
description: An essay publication set entirely in type: a dense index of pieces, a printed contents list, a reading room with a drop cap and marginal notes, and reading settings that persist.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of AstroPaper, not an unchanged upstream template.
No images anywhere: the identity is the type system, the measure, the rules and the margins. Every ornament is CSS or inline SVG written for this edition.
Set in one family, Source Serif 4, in three registers: display, text and capitals set small.
Reading settings persist in the browser: day or night, and three type sizes that carry the measure with them. The index filters by issue.
Every piece, contributor and issue is invented for the template and each page says so.
